title: Hotel Breakfast Kashrus Hacks
body: Rabbi Sholom Tendler shares travel tips on what to eat and avoid at hotel continental breakfasts to maintain kashrus. WATCH the full episode at kashrusawareness.com.

title: Rav Povarsky's New Elevator
body: Rav Berel Povarsky's home gets a new elevator, completed just hours before a gathering of Gedolei Yisroel. Rav Dov Landau and Rav Moshe Hillel Hirsch attended the event at Rav Povarsky's home.
